title: TarGEN: Targeted Data Generation with Large Language Models
measurement_description: Analysis of dataset bias by visualizing the distribution of tokens related to named entities, specifically the 'Nationalities or Religious or Political groups (NORP)' category, to compare the balance of representation between original and synthetically generated datasets.
religious_groups: Religious groups (as part of the NORP category)
findings: The distribution of NORP (Nationalities or Religious or Political groups) entities in the dataset generated by TarGEN closely resembles that of the original dataset, demonstrating a balanced representation and indicating that the method does not introduce additional bias for this category.
references: The claude 3 model family: Opus, sonnet, haiku. URL https://api.semanticscholar.org/CorpusID:268232499.
